2026-11-03.text:
WORLD OIL PRICES
October 26 - 30, 2026, Trading Days

Crude Oil Prices
The 44th price movement resulted in a total net increase of P13.50/liter for gasoline, P19.00/liter for diesel and P28.10/liter for kerosene.
